blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: FCI works to ensure complete food security across the nation.
Farmers are protected from market exploitation via Minimum Support Price (MSP) assured procurement.
Buffer stocks are maintained to stabilize price fluctuations during shortages.
Food grains are distributed effectively through various national welfare schemes.

blocks.content: • Protect farmers through assured procurement at Minimum Support Price (MSP).

items: FCI's procurement at Minimum Support Price (MSP) is a frequently asked concept in agricultural economy questions.
Remember that maintaining buffer stocks serves the dual purpose of price stabilization and emergency relief distribution.
Welfare scheme distribution via FCI forms the backbone of the Public Distribution System (PDS) in India.

blocks.content: • Maintain buffer stocks to stabilize prices.
• Distribute food grains through welfare schemes.
